blocks.text: Jab safed (white) light kisi compound par parti hai to ho sakta hai woh poori jazb (absorb) ho jaye, aur complex kaala dikhe. Ya compound saari light wapas (reflect) kar de ya guzar (transmit) jane de, aur safed dikhe. Teesri soorat: compound light ka kuch hissa jazb kare aur baqi reflect kare; tab complex us reflect hone wali light ke rang ka dikhta hai. Kitab ke mutabiq spectrum ke visible hisse mein light ke jazb aur emission se rang paida hota hai, is colour scheme ke mutabiq (Figure 18.6).
Jo rang hum dekhte hain woh jazb hone wali light ke rang ka ulat (complementary colour) hota hai. Maslan jo complex peeli (yellow) light jazb kare woh violet (banafshi) dikhta hai.

blocks.alt: Chhe barabar hisson wala rangon ka pahiya: oopar Orange, phir ghari ki sooiyon ki simt Yellow, Green, Blue, Violet aur Red. Aamne saamne ke hisse complementary rang hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.6: Complementary rang dikhane wala rangon ka pahiya (kitab ki Figure 18.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Jo rang jazb hota hai, us ke aamne saamne wala rang nazar aata hai. Yellow jazb ho to violet dikhta hai, orange jazb ho to blue, red jazb ho to green; aur ulat bhi: violet jazb ho to yellow, blue jazb ho to orange, green jazb ho to red.

Kam energy wale d-orbital ke electrons light jazb kar ke zyada energy wale d-orbital mein chale jate hain (excite hote hain). Electron ki is chhalang (transition) mein lagne wali light ki energy complex ka khaas rang banati hai. Jo light jazb nahi hoti woh aage guzar jati hai aur wohi rang tay karti hai. Is amal ko d-d transition kehte hain. d-d transition ki energy visible light ki ek khaas frequency (ν) aur wavelength (λ) ke barabar hoti hai, Planck's equation ke mutabiq: ΔE = hν = hc/λ (h Planck's constant aur c light ki raftaar hai).
Mukhtalif ligands ka ΔE aur rang par asar

Ligand ki qism splitting ΔE ki miqdar par asar karti hai. NH₃ aur CN⁻ jaise ligands zyada splitting karte hain (energy gap ΔE barhta hai), jab ke Cl⁻ aur I⁻ jaise ligands ke saath ΔE chhota hota hai. Zyada ΔE ka matlab hai ke zyada frequency (chhoti wavelength) wali, violet ya blue, light jazb hogi; is ke muqable mein yellow light reflect ho kar compound peela dikhta hai. Kuch complexes kam energy wali (red/orange) light jazb karte hain aur complementary scheme ke mutabiq blue ya green dikhte hain. Ligands ko d-orbital splitting ki salahiyat ke mutabiq (zyada ΔE se kam ΔE) yun tarteeb diya jata hai:

blocks.text_alt: CN⁻ > en > NH₃ > H₂O > OH⁻ > Cl⁻ > Br⁻ > I⁻

blocks.prompt: a) Ligands ki maujoodgi complex ion mein d-orbitals ki degeneracy par kaise asar karti hai?
blocks.explanation: Ligands ka electric field paanch degenerate d orbitals ko mukhtalif energy ke do non-degenerate sets mein baant deta hai.

blocks.prompt: b) Octahedral aur tetrahedral complexes ki d-orbital splitting mein bunyadi farq kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Octahedral: teen orbitals neeche aur do upar. Tetrahedral: ulta (do neeche, teen upar) aur splitting kam.

blocks.prompt: c) Jazb shuda light ki energy (ΔE) aur nazar aane wale rang ka taalluq Planck's equation (ΔE = hν = hc/λ) se samjhayein.
blocks.explanation: Zyada ΔE ka matlab zyada frequency aur chhoti wavelength wali light jazb hoti hai; nazar aane wala rang jazb hone wali light ka complementary rang hai.

blocks.prompt: d) Cl⁻ wala complex red/orange light jazb karta hai. Yeh kis rang ka dikhega?
blocks.explanation: Blue se green, jo orange aur red ke complementary rang hain.

blocks.prompt: e) Transition metal compounds ke rang ke zimmedar d-d transitions samjhayein.
blocks.explanation: Bate hue d orbitals mein neeche wale set ka electron ΔE ke barabar energy wala photon jazb kar ke upar wale set mein jata hai; woh rang white light se nikal jata hai aur baqi rang nazar aata hai.

items: Nazar aane wala rang = jazb hone wali light ka complementary rang.
Splitting: CN⁻ > en > NH₃ > H₂O > OH⁻ > Cl⁻ > Br⁻ > I⁻.
